test_series_round: test the Series.round() method to round numeric values to a specified number of decimal places
test_round_numpy: test using np.round() on a pandas Series with decimals parameter and unsupported out argument
test_round_builtin: test using Python's built-in round() function on a pandas Series with optional decimals argument
test_round_nat: test rounding NaT (Not-a-Time) datetime values with various frequency strings
test_round_non_numeric_noop: test that Series.round() is a no-op for non-numeric dtypes like string, category, and boolean
